description: Defines the ClientSocketPoolManager class and related functions for managing socket pools in the Chromium networking code. It includes method declarations for configuring socket pool parameters, retrieving socket pools, and initializing socket handles for HTTP and WebSocket requests.

classes.name: ClientSocketPoolManager
classes.description: Manages access to all ClientSocketPools, handling their lifetime and configuration.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_pool
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of sockets per pool for a given pool type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_pool
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of sockets per pool for a given pool type.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_group
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of sockets per group for a given pool type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_group
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of sockets per group for a given pool type.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_proxy_server
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of sockets per proxy server for a given pool type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_proxy_server
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of sockets per proxy server for a given pool type.

methods.name: unused_idle_socket_timeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for unused idle sockets for a given pool type.

methods.name: FlushSocketPoolsWithError
methods.description: Flushes socket pools with a specified error code and logs the reason.

methods.name: CloseIdleSockets
methods.description: Closes all idle sockets and logs the reason.

methods.name: GetSocketPool
methods.description: Retrieves the socket pool associated with a specific proxy server.

methods.name: SocketPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Creates a value summary of the current socket pool states.

methods.name: InitSocketHandleForHttpRequest
methods.description: Initializes a socket handle for an HTTP/HTTPS request using proxy info and SSL configs.

methods.name: InitSocketHandleForWebSocketRequest
methods.description: Initializes a socket handle for a WebSocket handshake request.

methods.name: PreconnectSocketsForHttpRequest
methods.description: Preconnects a specified number of streams for an HTTP request.
